questions.question: What does Hosea 9 announce about Israel?
options: A great harvest will soon fill the land
Days of punishment and exile have come
Days of peace and plenty are near
A new king will restore the throne
questions.answer: Days of punishment and exile have come

questions.question: Where does Hosea 9 say Israel would return to in judgment?
options: Jerusalem, where they thought that they would find a sure refuge
The wilderness, where they would wander about lost once again
Egypt (figuratively) and they would eat unclean food in Assyria
Babylon, where they would serve as captives for seventy long years
questions.answer: Egypt (figuratively) and they would eat unclean food in Assyria

questions.question: Hosea 9 says the prophet is considered a fool by the people because of their great iniquity.
The days of punishment have come; the days of _____ have come.
Like grapes in the wilderness, I found _____; like the first fruit on the fig tree.
